What changed:
- Converted your old habit notes into a dated table with **Walk, Read, Stretch, No phone in bed**
- Added today’s row so you can start ticking things off immediately
- Built a phone-friendly App side where you can:
  - tap habits to mark them done
  - switch days with arrows/date picker
  - see today’s completion
  - see current streaks
  - view a 14-day history grid
- Preserved your original freeform notes under **Original notes** in the text side.
